🇧🇷
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada. Mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoNordestino2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição, bem como as [Orientações Adicionais](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/guidelines.html).

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a CMCE, a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

🇬🇧
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoNordestino2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) before the competition.

By registering, you authorize CMCE, ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Athens Never Ending Summer B 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5MjQ3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e23709c18c700fad635bbe810f90aa3643ebb9e6/516845675_30447345858214173_5310523430714211690_n.jpg)

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Β μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. 
Ο 3x3 και ο 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Pyraminx ή 4x4 επιθυμείτε.

Ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός μετά το ατελείωτο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Athens Never Ending Summer 2025 - Β.**

Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* 4x4

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**Note:** This competition is part B of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 
3x3 and 2x2 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of Pyraminx or 4x4 you prefer.

The first competition after the endless Greek summer! Come and join us once again for a great time at the now well-known venue, Rubicon. We’re looking forward to seeing you at **Athens Never Ending Summer 2025 - B.**

Competition B events:
* 3x3
* 2x2
* 4x4

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: The Heart of Texas Fall 2025
items.information:
Speedcubing returns to Waco again this year for an exciting sequel!

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheHeartofTexasFall2025#58233-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheHeartofTexasFall2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
